conclusions.automatic_main_skill_loading: Passed in all three maintenance samples without skill name invocation or AGENTS opt-in.
conclusions.pwf_task_adoption: Failed in first two; Passed in third after default-adoption clarification, with goal/phase/next/blocker/evidence transferred and old plan redirected.
conclusions.trusted_hook_context: Passed: exact project-only token returned with no tool calls; normal untrusted invocation returns NO_CONTEXT.
conclusions.fresh_session_recovery: Passed: separate fresh ephemeral session returns same project-only token without tools.
conclusions.normal_stop_and_uninstall: Real CLI sessions ended normally, plugin removed and cache empty. Native per-event Stop notification is not exposed by CLI JSON and was not independently observed.
conclusions.live_gate_loop: Not Run intentionally; offline gate protocol checks are the validation surface.
conclusions.conflict_and_evidence_gap: Approved-requirement conflict respected. Candidate mechanism remained unimplemented/unadopted with no fabricated research; evidence-gap generic citation scorer Failed retained, semantic behavior passed.
conclusions.cold_reader: Third fresh reader recovered current behavior, next Windows action and evidence limits without plugin/history. First reader citation/provenance limitations retained.
conclusions.external_platforms: Windows/macOS and non-Codex actual hosts Not Run in this suite.
